title: WIP Dynamically Generated Language tool, with multiple voices and dynamic fonts, for SciFi/Cyberpunk/DarkFantasy/??? gamedevs
author: talamakina
selftext:
This is an "infinite language generator" tool, kinda.

I base the language derived from English and a seed. Another seed is used for the dynamic glyphs for each "word" in the language. From there, the tool produces a coherent, believable (because it has audio and visual glyphs too) dynamically generated language : 

* direct translations from English to generated language
* voiced audio, using multiple voice styles
* an "emotion editor" attached to each word
* prefabs that can be used for NPCs "speaking" the generated language.

  
Still a huge work in progress, but would love to contact fellow gamedevs who may want to integrate this now into their workflow!
